TYPE: pie chart
TITLE: Workforce Makeup by Race, 2010 to 2050 / Workforce Makeup by Ethnicity, 2010 to 2050
TEXT IN IMAGE:

 2050 Projected (donut chart center and label)

 Legend: Asian, Black, White, All Other
 Workforce Makeup by Ethnicity, 2010 to 2050
 2010 (donut chart center)
 Projected 2050 (donut chart center)

 30% (Hispanic, 2050)
 70% (Non-Hispanic, 2050)
 Legend: Hispanic, Non-Hispanic
 Source: Toossi, Mitra. "Projections of the Labor Force to 2050: A Visual Essay." Monthly Labor Review. Oct. 2012. Data from U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

DATA:
 Workforce Makeup by Race:
 - 2010: White 81%, Black 12%, Asian 5%, All Other 2%
 - Projected 2050: White 75%, Black 12%, Asian 8%, All Other 5%
 Workforce Makeup by Ethnicity:
 - 2010: Non-Hispanic 85%, Hispanic 15%
 - Projected 2050: Non-Hispanic 70%, Hispanic 30%

KEY FACTS:
- The percentage of White workers is projected to decrease from 81% in 2010 to 75% in 2050.
- The percentage of Asian workers is projected to increase from 5% in 2010 to 8% in 2050.
- The percentage of Black workers remains unchanged at 12% between 2010 and 2050.
- The percentage of Hispanic workers is projected to double from 15% in 2010 to 30% in 2050.
- Non-Hispanic workers make up the majority of the workforce in both years, decreasing from 85% in 2010 to 70% in 2050.
